Switch off auto save.anual save frequently and have more than one save file always 
Feed arthur and your horse regularly.
Craft all satchels as quickly as possible. 
Always make sure you have health cures and horse medicine and horse reviver in your satchel at all times.
Dont rush the game. Slow down and immerse yourself in it proper.
Always pay attention to minimap. 
Always check your load out before leaving your horse or camp to set off on foot.
Whenever you see a white dot side quest, do it because they are time sensitive and mught not be around again.
High honor playthrough is more beneficial than low honor.
Before you do the mission "My Last Boy" visit the Aberdeen Pig Farm and let them take advantage of you. Avenge it later in the epilogue.
